name: Uranian-Moulin

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by impact-scarred wastelands and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Whoever abandoned ancient alien ruins did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
